steps.speaker: Gang member
steps.content: Stop!
In the narrow alley, the tall man grabs the boy by his sleeve and throws him onto the ground violently.

steps.speaker: Gang member
steps.content: Give it back!

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: I didn't steal anything from you...

steps.speaker: Gang member
steps.content: **** you! All you do is lie, you little punks!
The man throws a solid punch.

steps.speaker: Gang member
steps.content: Where are your friends? Where did you hide the things you've stolen, you little *******?!
The screeching screams sound especially raucous in the alley.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: I don't know... I don't know!
Almost out of breath, the boy is sobbing and pleading, but there's not a hint of mercy on the man's face.

steps.speaker: Gang member
steps.content: You know, you're useless if you won't talk, you little son of a bitch...
The man raises his dagger high in the air.
You don't have any weapons on you that can resist the dagger, so you do the only thing you can. You catch it with your hand.
The man seems stunned by your sudden intrusion. He only begins to curse a moment later.

steps.speaker: Gang member
steps.content: Who the **** are you?!
He raises the dagger again, ready to also get rid of you who's interrupting his business. Suddenly, a horrifying chill seeps into every pore on his back.
The chill spreads from his spine all the way to the back of his head. The dagger in his grip frozen mid-air, he turns back slowly and mechanically to see a dark petite figure.

The next moment, the shadow wriggling on the ground solidifies and pierces hard into the man's abdomen. He's overturned by this massive power like a ragdoll being pulled and twisted by a mischievous child.
Hold on, Crache!
We can get leads about those gangsters out of him.
You reach out your hand. The wound cut by the dagger is bleeding, but you don't have time for it now.
If you don't stop her, after what the man's done to the boy, you're sure Crache is going to take his life.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Mind your own business.

The two gangsters guarding the entrance of the alley have also already flopped down and fallen silent. If that two men hadn't slowed Crache down, you probably wouldn't have had to grab that dagger yourself.
They're not dead, are they?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: No, but it'll be a while before they can move.
Crache answers half-heartedly. She ignores you and walks straight to that boy. The shadow scoops him up gently.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Cr... Crache? You're back?!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Hmm... Yeah.
Crache mumbles in response to the boy's question.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Finally! No one knew where you'd gone, we were all so worried about you!
The boy looks at her with wide eyes and flashes a smile with two front teeth missing.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Hmm, I'm fine.
The boy seems so accustomed to Crache's coldness that his expression doesn't change. Until he sees you behind Crache.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Who's... this man?
An instinctive vigilance emerges on the boy's face. Even though you've just saved him, his distrust of adults can't be so easily erased.
As you try to come up with an explanation, Crache glances at the wound on your hand, and surprisingly, speaks for you.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Don't mind him. He came with me. He's not dangerous.
steps.female_content: Don't mind her. She came with me. She's not dangerous.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Let's go to the base. I need to talk to them.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Are you coming to the Playground too? Hurray!
Cheering, the boy seems to have completely forgotten about the danger he just got out of.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: You haven't been back in ages. Everyone misses you!
Led by the boy, you take a long time to traverse the complex, meandering streets of Syndicate.
Finally, you stop in front of a small playground.
It's an incredibly crude facility with nothing other than a swing and a slide. Around it, tall, run-down buildings block the sun, shrouding the dilapidated playground with a thick shadow.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Look who's back?
Many tiny mushrooms peek out from under the slide.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Crache?

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Crache's back!
A dozen black mushrooms come running to Crache. They surround her, all hopping and cheering as if they're having some kind of festive celebration.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: The Almighty Crache!

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: I've missed you so much, wahhhh...

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Those bastards have begun bullying us again while you were away.
The Homeless have completely surrounded Crache, all chirping non-stop. Despite that, some of the more alert children have noticed you.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Why is an adult following you?
Several kids mumble as they reach for the weapons on their waists.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: He's different from the others. He's here to help us... I suppose
steps.female_content: She's different from the others. She's here to help us... I suppose.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: An adult? Here to help us?!
Though they find this hard to believe, they don't doubt it. After all, their trusty Almighty Crache has said so.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: By the way, I've found this. I'm sure you'll like it!
A small hand lifts a recorder among the crowd, flaunting it in Crache's face desperately.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Stop it, you're gonna stick it in her nose...

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Here's a picture card I've found. I've been saving it for you!

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: I've got one too!
The kids all scramble to shove their gifts at Crache. The first boy you've met has even brought over a globe-shaped candy vending machine out of nowhere.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Beans nicked this last month. We've saved all the blueberry-flavored ones for you.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I hate lollipops... Ugh...
A bluish-purple lollipop is shoved into Crache's mouth. She frowns and begins to grumble, but seems to suddenly find the taste quite pleasant.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Just pass it to me next time, don't shove it at me like that...
In the middle of her sentence, Crache notices you staring at her. She glares at you with some irritation and doesn't finish.
A quarter of an hour later, the kids of the Homeless finally quiet down.

options: Ask them about the Mania Crystals

choices.text: Ask them about the Mania Crystals

steps.content: You look at Crache, who instantly realizes what you want to do. She frowns slightly but doesn't stop you.
With Crache's approval, you walk over to the boy next to the candy vending machine.
I'd like to ask you a few questions. Can I?
The boy clutches the candy vending machine instinctively and flinches. He looks at Crache, then at you, and answers after a moment of hesitation.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: What do you want to know?
The kids' attention is all on you now. Apparently, a conversation with an adult is not a common scene in their daily lives.
Have you heard of Mania Crystal?
The boy looks slightly perplexed at the question, and most of the other kids simply look at one another in confusion. Only very few of them seem to react to the term.
You go on.
It's a red, translucent, and irregularly shaped stone.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: I've heard of it. That stone is no joke, you can sell it for so much money. One piece for a hundred candies.
Hearing the boy link Mania Crystals directly to money, a shadow flickers over Crache's face.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: That sounds useless. We never pay to get our candies anyway. That's why I joined the Homeless.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Is it the kind of red stone Sandy and the others have found recently? I think I've seen it...
At the mention of Sandy, Crache's face changes completely.
But the kids haven't noticed the changes in Crache's expression and continue chattering.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Sandy is our deputy boss.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Yes, she's the brain of the Homeless. She's awesome, the right-hand woman of the Almighty Crache! Even adults are respectful to her.
Do you know where she is now?

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: She came back once last month, saying she got a big job... I think she's gone to get those red stones?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Enough!
Crache interrupts abruptly. The kids finally notice the look on her face.
They exchange looks with each other and look at you, finally realizing they've spilled more than they should have.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Sorry, Crache, I forgot there's an adult here...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I'm not mad because of that.
The atmosphere is still tense. The kids dare not go on further.
You don't want me to know about Sandy, do you?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: That's none of your business.
But you heard the kids. Sandy's found the red stones recently... You're mad because she's actually touched those Mania Crystals, aren't you?
Our priority is to solve the problem. We must find Sandy.
Crache's face is stiff with a complex expression. She seems caught in some thoughts anxiously and pays no mind to you.
The awkward silence goes on. After a while, one of the kids suddenly asks sheepishly.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: That red stone, is it dangerous?
Yes. Very, very dangerous. Ordinary people get hurt simply by touching it.
This type of injury is hard to heal. Most people will even turn into monsters because of it.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: W-what should we do then... Sandy hasn't come back since the end of last month. She can't have...

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Don't say that! I'm sure Sandy's fine.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: But... But Beans and Melon have gone with her too, and we haven't heard from them since.
Hold on. You're saying besides Sandy, you've lost contact with other members of the Homeless as well?

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: Yeah... Normally everyone swings by once every few days.

steps.speaker: The Homeless" Member
steps.content: But Beans, Melon, and a few others haven't been back in a long time...
A strange premonition hits you suddenly. You turn to the boy beside the candy machine.
The guy who chased you today. Why was he coming after you? What happened between you?

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: I don't know? I haven't done anything special these days. It wasn't even me who nicked the candy machine...

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: That guy just started hitting me randomly. I don't know him at all.
Missing members of the Homeless. Gangsters going crazy. Stolen Mania Crystals.
A terrifying theory is forming in your brain. You stride up to Crache.
Thou Voodoos didn't attack the Homeless by chance. You've become their target.
Crache's face stiffens. She too has realized the severity of the situation.
Sandy... I'm afraid she's their primary target. Does she have a hideout? Somewhere only you guys know about?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...I don't know.
No, I wasn't thinking straight. If she's fleeing, she most likely won't stay in a fixed spot... We must find her asap.
You call Nightingale immediately.
Tell the intelligence department to locate members of the Homeless and anyone that looks like they belong to Thou Voodoos. I need their real-time locations.
Quick!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Copy that.
Five minutes later, a dynamic map is sent to your personal device.
The packed green dots give you a headache. Even if you mobilize the entire MBCC, it's impossible to screen all of them within a short time.
Crache, you can reach every shadow in Syndicate with your ability. You're the only one who can do this...
I can trust you, right?
You pass your personal device to Crache. She takes a quick glance at the screen and activates her power without hesitation.
In a split second, the small body fuses with the shadow and disappears.
In a back alley piled with trash, a pink-haired girl is panting heavily. She's hiding inside a metal trash can, trying her best to ignore the menacing laughter of those scary adults.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: You can't hide forever, you little bastard! Give us back the Mania Crystals!
She keeps praying silently that those scary adults will not find her. Despite her wish, she hears the footsteps nearing and her heart leaps to her throat.
Creak...

The pink-haired girl freezes for a moment before she leaps up from the trash can and with all her strength, hugs the person before her. Standing before her is not the Thou Voodoos guys hunting her down, but her long-missing dear friend.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Crache... Crache...

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: You've finally come back to save me, I almost got killed...

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: But we'll have nothing to worry about anymore, I've just made a hefty sum. I can protect the Homeless without you from now on.
Sandy lets go of her friend whom she's been missing dearly. But right now, the Crache before her looks scarily glum.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: You haven't shown up in a while... I thought you...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Got into a little trouble. Nothing serious.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Did you steal the Mania Crystals?
Sandy freezes for a second, then flashes a big smile.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Of course not. Why would I touch that dangerous stuff?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Yeah? Thou Voodoos doesn't seem to think so.
At the mention of Thou Voodoos, Sandy starts unconsciously and peeks at the entrance of the alley.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Where are they?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Got rid of them.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Haha, I knew it!
Sandy smiles again. She brushes off the trash stuck to her clothes and crawls out of the trash can.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: ...Look, it's just a misunderstanding. I stole a batch from them, but it's certainly not Mania Crystals. I'm not sure why they keep chasing after me.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Really?
Sensing the doubt in her friend's tone, Sandy explains immediately.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Yes, Crache, yes. You're the last person I'll lie to.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Why the worried look? Aren't you back now? If those pushovers from Thou Voodoos dare mess with the Homeless, you'll get rid of them.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Just like in the old days. Right?
To Sandy's surprise, Crache doesn't give her an affirmative response right away. Her expression still looks severe.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Are you sure you didn't touch the Mania Crystals?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: How many times do I have to say this? No.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Why are you all worked up? Is there something you can't settle?
Crache is not in the mood for this type of questions from her. She simply asks about the other members of the Homeless.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Where are the others who came with you? Are they being chased too?
The lack of direct response from Crache unsettles Sandy a little. She answers promptly.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: No, I've asked them to go and hide in the old depot. Melon's gone to notify the base. It's gonna be okay.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: ...Are things really that bad?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: What do you think?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Leave here immediately. Someone tricky may follow me here soon.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Who? Thou Voodoos?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...The Bureau's Chief.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: The Bureau's Chief... You mean the one who caught you? I've heard he's kind of a yes-man...
steps.female_content: The Bureau's Chief... You mean the one who caught you? I've heard she's kind of a yes-woman...

steps.content: Sandy's eyes suddenly light up.
Though Crache has taken your device and left on her own, you've been tracking her with the shackles.
Finally, you find Crache in a hidden alley.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Crache, have you found Sandy?
Seeing you, Crache puts herself in front of Sandy instinctively.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Stay away!
Relax, Crache. I'm not here to punish you. We'll provide shelter for Sandy, then we'll find out the truth about the Mania Crystals.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I'll protect her. We don't need your help.
Surprisingly, it's Sandy who raises a question first.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: So you're that Chief?
Yes.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: You said you could protect me? Good, take me with you now.
Sandy's words surprise both you and Crache, but you collect yourself quickly.
No problem, but...

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: I know what you're thinking. I didn't steal Thou Voodoos' Mania Crystals, but I know who did it. The way I see it, they want us as their scapegoats in their dog-eat-dog games.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: How about we make a deal? You want to find the Mania Crystals, don't you? I can help you, given that you ensure my safety.
Just your safety? What about the other kids of the Homeless?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Don't worry, they'll be fine. I've made them go to a highly secure hideout. They only have to wait it out until you catch all of those Thou Voodoos bastards.
A highly secure hideout?
You ask a little suspiciously. Seeing your reaction, Sandy explains slightly impatiently.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: God, what an idiot. Their primary target is me. Why would I possibly go there now? Won't I be exposing the location?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Anyway, if you don't say yes, Crache won't help you! We're best friends. She'll listen to whatever I say!
As she speaks, she tugs at Crache's sleeve.
Crache, are you sure that hideout is safe? Will the other members of the Homeless involved be okay? Do you need my help?
Crache hesitates for a moment and finally decides to trust her good friend. She gives you an affirmative answer.
Alright then.
Okay, I'll help you.
The MBCC will send a team here to capture the Thou Voodoos guys, and you can follow me back to the Bureau for now.
But you must keep your promise and help me find the stolen Mania Crystals...

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: No problem!
Sandy agrees fervently.
